prior_access: All aggregate scores were already known. A prior independent arithmetic audit read raw forecasts, calibration labels and daily scores to reproduce the registered E022 report. Station/horizon error summaries and these four-comparison bootstrap intervals were not examined before this diagnostic declaration. This is post-result development diagnosis, not untouched validation.
panel: Use every one of the 6599 shared development case IDs, all 20 eligible stations, all horizons 1/3/6 and all 28 UTC target days. Original 37-station calendar exclusions remain unchanged. Do not add, remove, rank-select or retune cases/models based on errors.
slice_summaries: Report all 8 models by all 20 stations by all 3 horizons (480 rows), plus all model/station and model/horizon margins. Each slice reports case/day counts, mean absolute error, root mean squared error and signed mean error using equal UTC target-day weights and equal cases within each day. Every negative comparison slice is retained.
aggregate_comparison: For each of four fixed reference models, compute fixed-fit minus reference absolute error on identical cases, average within UTC target day, then equally across all 28 days. Negative favors fixed-fit. Preserve all daily differences.
concentration: For each reference, retain station and horizon contributions to aggregate MAE reduction: mean over28days of that group's sum(reference absolute error minus fixed-fit absolute error) divided by the total panel case count for that day. Contributions sum exactly to the aggregate gain. Retain negative contributions. Report win/tie/loss counts over20station means,3horizon means,60station-horizon means and28daily means.

bootstrap.generator: numpy.random.default_rng; four independently sampled circular block starts per draw, each followed by7consecutive UTCday indexes modulo28; identical sampled days across all4comparisons
bootstrap.statistic: For comparison j estimate SE_j as sample standard deviation(ddof1) of its10000resampled means. Per draw take max_j(abs(resampled_mean_j-observed_mean_j)/SE_j). Critical value is the95th percentile using method=higher. Report simultaneous descriptive intervals observed_mean_j plus/minus critical*SE_j. Exactly zero-variance comparisons get their point interval and do not enter the maximum; retain their status.
bootstrap.retention: Archive all resampled means and the shared sampled-day index SHA256. No pvalues, subgroup confidence intervals, or significance labels. The fixed block length, candidate family and seed are not retried. Intervals are exploratory development uncertainty, not proof after a search.

limits: No new model fitting, inference, policy choice, market-price evaluation, network requests or real trades. No claim of untouched validation, statistical discovery, profitability, or promotion. TWC station temperatures are not KXTEMPMIAH index settlement labels.
